name: qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin_mu-mu1-COMMIT
purpose: KV-side MU d2d calendar sequencer (MU-DIE-KV2 / KV-DCAL-MU 10-19): qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin built from ot_qwen_d2d_cal_seq_dies_mu.sv + d2d_cal_image_mu.svh (D2D_MU=1 d2d_cal_image_production.sh on the MU release pair seam 2,2,2,3,2,2/11,11,9,9,9,9,9: TXDP_C 0x0a010308, TXDP_K 0x03030415 [21,4,3,3] = production d2d_cal_image.svh; MU context slot = +1 K TX / C RX entry, SEG2 8->9). Same ports/outline/pins as _ep3 (die slot DCAL_WH 18.792x28.08); replaces the ep3 labelled stand-in when OT_KV_MU=1. Static calendar, no credits/backpressure; reset landing 2 stages (boot constant).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin #(.EP_SKEW(3), .GO_OFS(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/qwen_sys/d2d_static_20261015 --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/d2d_static_20261015/qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin.sv rtl/qwen_sys/d2d_static_20261015/ot_qwen_d2d_cal_seq_dies_mu.sv rtl/qwen_sys/d2d_static_20261015/ot_qwen_d2d_cal_seq.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: mu_compiled_timeline_and_exception_deadlines
bench.pass_regex: CALPIN_PASS starts74 layers72 token3start1 bootwords66 reloadwords66 resetwords66 halt_capture1 reset_release2

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin_mu/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin_mu/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin_mu --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Copy of the CLOSED _ep3 kit (TT/FF closed 10-16, synth 156 um2, 45% std util in 18.792x28.08) with the MU calendar image: one more K TX image word (constant), SEG2 9; no RTL structure, pin, outline or cycle change. Recipe 3 kept; reset_landing 2 stages added (ROOT-RST 10-19); io_hold_margin 0.03.
